problems.memo_sentence: The book provides a broad survey of quantum computing methods, covering foundational concepts (qubits, gates, circuit models), core algorithms such as Shor’s, Grover’s, variational quantum algorithms, and quantum simulation, as well as discussions of quantum architectures (superconducting qubits, trapped ions, photonic systems) and hybrid quantum–classical frameworks.
